healthAuthorities.name: Socialstyrelsen (National Board of Health and Welfare)
healthAuthorities.description: Sweden's national health authority; DG Bjorn Eriksson since Aug 2024. National digital-health infrastructure jointly operated by Inera AB (state/region-owned) and E-halsomyndigheten.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Stockholm
healthAuthorities.description: Population 2,486,253 (2025). Region on legacy TakeCare; contracted Cambio COSMIC Nov 2025 (target ~2029). Capio S:t Goran (private, KGC member) already on COSMIC.

healthAuthorities.name: Vastra Gotalandsregionen (VGR)
healthAuthorities.description: Population 1,777,794 (2025). Abandoned Cerner/Oracle Health Millennium after 3-day 2024 live rollout; runs legacy Melior/Asynja Visph/Obstetrix; new modular EPR strategy from 2 Dec 2025.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Skane
healthAuthorities.description: Population 1,433,082 (2025). Abandoned Cerner/Oracle Health Millennium 29 Apr 2026 without any production go-live; runs legacy Melior (hospitals) + PMO (primary care).

healthAuthorities.name: Region Ostergotland
healthAuthorities.description: Population 472,530 (2025). KGC consortium - Cambio COSMIC.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Uppsala
healthAuthorities.description: Population 410,572 (2025). KGC consortium - Cambio COSMIC.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Jonkopings lan
healthAuthorities.description: Population 369,721 (2025). KGC consortium - Cambio COSMIC.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Halland
healthAuthorities.description: Population 346,087 (2025). Sussa Samverkan - Cambio COSMIC, go-live ~Mar 2025.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Orebro lan
healthAuthorities.description: Population 308,362 (2025). Sussa Samverkan first-mover - Cambio COSMIC go-live 19 Sept 2024.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Sormland
healthAuthorities.description: Population 300,436 (2025). Sussa Samverkan - Cambio COSMIC go-live Sept 2025.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Dalarna
healthAuthorities.description: Population 286,048 (2025). Sussa Samverkan - Cambio COSMIC go-live Oct 2025 (delayed from Feb 2025).

healthAuthorities.name: Region Gavleborg
healthAuthorities.description: Population 283,449 (2025). Sussa Samverkan - Cambio COSMIC go-live ~Jan 2025.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Varmland
healthAuthorities.description: Population 283,028 (2025). KGC consortium - Cambio COSMIC.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Vastmanland
healthAuthorities.description: Population 280,762 (2025). KGC consortium - Cambio COSMIC.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Vasterbotten
healthAuthorities.description: Population 279,024 (2025). Sussa Samverkan - Cambio COSMIC go-live ~Apr 2025.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Norrbotten
healthAuthorities.description: Population 248,918 (2025). Sussa Samverkan - Cambio COSMIC go-live 23 Nov 2024, replaced VAS after 30 years.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Kalmar lan
healthAuthorities.description: Population 245,483 (2025). KGC consortium - Cambio COSMIC.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Vasternorrland
healthAuthorities.description: Population 240,641 (2025). Sussa Samverkan - Cambio COSMIC go-live ~Feb 2025.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Kronoberg
healthAuthorities.description: Population 203,122 (2025). KGC consortium - Cambio COSMIC.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Blekinge
healthAuthorities.description: Population 156,620 (2025). Sussa Samverkan - Cambio COSMIC go-live 18 Nov 2025.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Jamtland Harjedalen
healthAuthorities.description: Population 132,736 (2025). KGC consortium - Cambio COSMIC.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Gotland
healthAuthorities.description: Population 60,852 (2025). Bundled into Stockholm's Nov 2025 Cambio COSMIC contract; legacy TakeCare, target ~2029.

hospitalGroups.name: Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset
hospitalGroups.notes: Single legal entity, Solna + Huddinge campuses (2004 merger). Includes Astrid Lindgrens Barnsjukhus at Solna.

hospitalGroups.name: Danderyds Sjukhus
hospitalGroups.notes: Division within Akutsjukhusnamnden. ~4,500 staff.

hospitalGroups.name: Sodersjukhuset (SoS)
hospitalGroups.notes: Under Akutsjukhusnamnden. Opened 1944.

hospitalGroups.name: Sodertalje Sjukhus AB
hospitalGroups.notes: Separate limited company, wholly owned by Region Stockholm. Teaching ties to Karolinska Institutet.

hospitalGroups.name: Capio S:t Gorans Sjukhus AB
hospitalGroups.notes: Org.nr 556479-1456. Owned by Capio AB, part of Ramsay Sante since Nov 2018. Sweden's first acute hospital as a limited company (1994) and first privately-owned acute hospital (1999).

hospitalGroups.name: Vardbolaget TioHundra AB
hospitalGroups.notes: Joint venture, Region Stockholm + Norrtalje kommun.

hospitalGroups.name: S:t Eriks Ogonsjukhus
hospitalGroups.notes: Ownership form disputed across sources (public unit within Akutsjukhusnamnden vs. separate 'S:t Eriks Ogonsjukhus AB') — needs re-verification.

hospitalGroups.name: SLSO Norra Stockholms Psykiatri
hospitalGroups.notes: Stockholms lans sjukvardsomrade (SLSO), Region Stockholm. Distinct entity from Capio S:t Goran despite co-location.

hospitalGroups.name: Rattspsykiatri Vard Stockholm
hospitalGroups.notes: Public forensic psychiatric service, one of several tenants in the Lowenstromska sjukhuset multi-tenant clinical building (Locum-owned; original hospital closed 1993).

hospitalGroups.name: Capio (Lowenstromska tenants)
hospitalGroups.notes: Capio-operated clinics within the Lowenstromska sjukhuset multi-tenant building, contracted by Region Stockholm.

hospitalGroups.name: Sahlgrenska Universitetssjukhuset
hospitalGroups.notes: Group total ~1,600 beds, 17,000+ employees. Never went live on Millennium — ran Melior throughout.

hospitalGroups.name: NU-sjukvarden
hospitalGroups.notes: Group total 535 inpatient beds (somatic+psychiatric), ~4,900 employees, serves ~270,000 (Fyrbodal + Lilla Edet).

hospitalGroups.name: Sodra Alvsborgs Sjukhus (SAS)
hospitalGroups.notes: Serves ~300,000 (Sjuharad). Group bed count not confirmed.

hospitalGroups.name: Skaraborgs Sjukhus (SkaS)
hospitalGroups.notes: Covers Skovde/Lidkoping/Falkoping/Mariestad, ~30 specialties. Bed/employee totals not confirmed (only dated 2018 reporting found).

hospitalGroups.name: Sjukhusen i vaster (SiV)
hospitalGroups.notes: ~3,000 employees group-wide, own board.

hospitalGroups.name: Skanes universitetssjukhus (SUS)
hospitalGroups.notes: Merged 2010 from former Lund + Malmo/UMAS hospitals. Own Sjukhusstyrelse Sus.

hospitalGroups.name: Skanes sjukhus nordvast
hospitalGroups.notes: Groups Helsingborg + Angelholm; exact board structure (unified forvaltning vs per-site) needs double-checking.

hospitalGroups.name: Skanes sjukhus nordost
hospitalGroups.notes: Groups Kristianstad + Hassleholm.

hospitalGroups.name: Lasarettet i Ystad
hospitalGroups.notes: ~1,000 staff. Governance grouping unconfirmed.

hospitalGroups.name: Lasarettet Trelleborg
hospitalGroups.notes: ~600 staff.

hospitalGroups.name: Lasarettet i Landskrona
hospitalGroups.notes: ~390 staff. Administrative placement (nordvast ties vs own Sjukhusstyrelse Landskrona) unconfirmed.

hospitalGroups.name: Capio Narsjukhus Simrishamn
hospitalGroups.notes: Praktikertjanst originally held the contract; Capio (Capio Aldre och Mobil Vard) took over 1 May 2021, initial 6-year contract + option to extend 4 more (potentially through 2031). Direct service contract with Region Skane (Halso- och sjukvardsnamnden), not part of the region's 'eight hospitals' structure.

hospitalGroups.name: Akademiska sjukhuset
hospitalGroups.notes: Region Uppsala + Uppsala University.

hospitalGroups.name: Lasarettet i Enkoping
hospitalGroups.notes: Works closely with Akademiska.

hospitalGroups.name: Universitetssjukhuset i Linkoping (US)
hospitalGroups.notes: Academically integrated with Linkoping University (Halsouniversitetet). Founded 1782, current site since 1895, current name since 1992.

hospitalGroups.name: Vrinnevisjukhuset
hospitalGroups.notes: County hospital for eastern Ostergotland.

hospitalGroups.name: Lasarettet i Motala
hospitalGroups.notes: ~1,100 staff.

hospitalGroups.name: Lanssjukhuset Ryhov
hospitalGroups.notes: Tertiary/central site for the county's ~356,000 residents.

hospitalGroups.name: Varnamo sjukhus
hospitalGroups.notes: Opened 1976, serves ~96,000, ~1,300 staff (~125 doctors).

hospitalGroups.name: Centrallasarettet Vaxjo
hospitalGroups.notes: Large campus, multiple entrances — address disambiguation needed (Sodra Jarnvagsgatan 1 vs Strandvagen 8).

hospitalGroups.name: Lasarettet Ljungby
hospitalGroups.notes: Feb 2025 investigation report notes Ljungby's wards are organisationally somewhat dependent on Vaxjo capacity.

hospitalGroups.name: Lanssjukhuset i Kalmar
hospitalGroups.notes: A 'Lasarettsvagen 1' address variant also seen, likely a different campus wing.

hospitalGroups.name: Universitetssjukhuset Orebro (USO)
hospitalGroups.notes: One of three hospitals in Region Orebro lan's hospital system (with Lindesberg, Karlskoga).

hospitalGroups.name: Karlskoga lasarett
hospitalGroups.notes: Opened 1942, catchment ~70,000 (Orebro + Varmland counties).

hospitalGroups.name: Visby lasarett
hospitalGroups.notes: Region Gotland. Sole hospital on the island, serves ~61,000.

hospitalGroups.name: Blekingesjukhuset
hospitalGroups.notes: Two campuses under one organisational name; precise clinical division of labour between sites not confirmed.

hospitalGroups.name: Hallands sjukhus
hospitalGroups.notes: Three sites under one organisational name; only Halmstad + Varberg have a full ED.

hospitalGroups.name: Vastmanlands sjukhus
hospitalGroups.notes: Two sites under one organisational name.

hospitalGroups.name: Falu lasarett
hospitalGroups.notes: Region's specialist-care hub.

hospitalGroups.name: Avesta lasarett
hospitalGroups.notes: Founded 1922.

hospitalGroups.name: Ludvika lasarett
hospitalGroups.notes: Founded 1924.

hospitalGroups.name: Saters sjukhus (Skonvik)
hospitalGroups.notes: Regional psychiatric hospital.

hospitalGroups.name: Bollnas sjukhus
hospitalGroups.notes: Acute-care status not explicitly confirmed.

hospitalGroups.name: Sundsvalls sjukhus
hospitalGroups.notes: Also known as Lanssjukhuset Sundsvall-Harnosand.

hospitalGroups.name: Ostersunds sjukhus
hospitalGroups.notes: Region's only acute hospital.

hospitalGroups.name: Norrlands universitetssjukhus (NUS)
hospitalGroups.notes: Tertiary referral centre for Ovre Norrland, ~5,000 employees. One of Vasterbotten's two 'regional division' hospitals with Skelleftea.

hospitalGroups.name: Skelleftea lasarett
hospitalGroups.notes: Specialisms knee replacement, gallbladder/colon surgery.

hospitalGroups.name: Lycksele sjukhus
hospitalGroups.notes: Catchment ~40,000, ~600 staff. Specialisms hip replacement, bariatric surgery, hernia, prolapse.

hospitalGroups.name: Sunderby sjukhus
hospitalGroups.notes: Competency centre for all Norrbotten healthcare, borders Boden.

hospitalGroups.name: Gallivare sjukhus
hospitalGroups.notes: Serves Gallivare/Kiruna/Jokkmokk/Pajala.

hospitalGroups.name: Kalix sjukhus
hospitalGroups.notes: Serves Kalix/Haparanda/Overtornea/Overkalix.

hospitalGroups.name: Kiruna sjukhus
hospitalGroups.notes: Sweden's northernmost hospital. A new Kiruna hospital is in development (LKAB city-relocation driven); construction-partner contract signed Apr 2026, completion ~2030.

hospitalGroups.name: Pitea sjukhus
hospitalGroups.notes: County hospital, planned-orthopaedics centre.

hospitalGroups.name: Malarsjukhuset
hospitalGroups.notes: Sormlands storsta sjukhus. New care building (14 theatres incl. 1 hybrid, 14-bed neonatal ward) completing with move-in expected 2026.

hospitalGroups.name: Regionsjukhuset Karsudden
hospitalGroups.notes: Transferred from state to county ownership 1 Jul 1967. Serves Sormland + referrals from Stockholm/Gotland.

hospitalGroups.name: Centralsjukhuset i Karlstad (CSK)
hospitalGroups.notes: 'Nya CSK' new-build programme underway.

hospitalSites.name: Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset Solna
hospitalSites.notes: Combined Solna+Huddinge beds: 1,340 (2024); per-campus split unconfirmed. Includes Astrid Lindgrens Barnsjukhus.

hospitalSites.name: Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset Huddinge
hospitalSites.notes: Adult ED relocated to Blickagangen 9c, plan 5, 17 Sept 2024. Beds included in 1,340 combined total.

hospitalSites.name: Sodersjukhuset
hospitalSites.beds_notes: ~520 disponibla vardplatser; 4,699 employees; ~131,000 ED visits 2024 (sodersjukhuset.se, updated 22 Jul 2026).

hospitalSites.name: Sodertalje Sjukhus
hospitalSites.notes: Acute + basic specialist care; runs specialised care jointly with Sodersjukhuset/Karolinska.

hospitalSites.name: Capio S:t Gorans Sjukhus
hospitalSites.notes: Catchment ~420,000 (13 Stockholm districts); >100,000 ED visits (2019); ~1,500 staff. Beds unconfirmed.

hospitalSites.name: Norrtalje Sjukhus
hospitalSites.notes: Small acute hospital: 24/7 basic acute, ICU, radiology, surgery, ED; no obstetrics. Street address unconfirmed.

hospitalSites.name: S:t Eriks Ogonsjukhus
hospitalSites.notes: Eye hospital. ~485 staff; ~189,000 visits/yr, ~31,000 ED visits, ~1,400 inpatient stays, ~10,000 ops/yr. Beds unconfirmed.

hospitalSites.name: Norra Stockholms Psykiatri - S:t Goran
hospitalSites.beds_notes: 139 ward beds across 9 departments + 14-bed observation unit at psychiatric ED.
hospitalSites.notes: Catchment ~500,000 (Bromma, Hasselby-Vallingby, Kungsholmen, Norrmalm, Ostermalm, Ekero kommun).

hospitalSites.name: Lowenstromska sjukhuset - Rattspsykiatri Sektion Nord
hospitalSites.notes: 5 wards, forensic psychiatric inpatient. Building shared with private Capio tenants (see separate group).

hospitalSites.name: Capio Geriatrik Lowet
hospitalSites.notes: Acute geriatric inpatient, 2 wards + memory clinic.

hospitalSites.name: Capio Ortho Center Stockholm
hospitalSites.notes: Hip/knee orthopaedic surgery, inpatient ward floor 7.

hospitalSites.name: Capio Stockholm Spine Center
hospitalSites.notes: Sweden's largest spine clinic; inpatient + outpatient.

hospitalSites.name: Sahlgrenska sjukhuset
hospitalSites.notes: Melior confirmed for psychiatry/clinical genetics/paediatrics/forensic psychiatry. Per-campus bed split not found (group total ~1,600).

hospitalSites.name: Ostra sjukhuset
hospitalSites.notes: Includes Drottning Silvias barnsjukhus (children's hospital).

hospitalSites.name: Hogsbo sjukhus (Sahlgrenska)
hospitalSites.notes: Sahlgrenska outpatient site, distinct from nearby Hogsbo narsjukhus (SiV).

hospitalSites.name: Ragarden
hospitalSites.notes: Psychiatric facility under Sahlgrenska; address unconfirmed.

hospitalSites.name: Norra Alvsborgs Lanssjukhus (NAL)
hospitalSites.notes: Primary acute site of NU-sjukvarden.

hospitalSites.name: Uddevalla sjukhus
hospitalSites.notes: Planned/elective focus.

hospitalSites.name: Brinkasen
hospitalSites.notes: Forensic/adult psychiatric hospital.

hospitalSites.name: SAS Boras
hospitalSites.notes: MILLENNIUM SITE: went live 12 Nov 2024 05:30, halted 15 Nov 2024 after chaotic first days (radiology reverted to paper, acute intake restricted, patients diverted to Sahlgrenska, 10 Lex Maria reports). Reverted to Melior by 20 Nov 2024.

hospitalSites.name: SAS Skene
hospitalSites.notes: Millennium status at hospital-site level uncertain — Narhalsan Skene primary care requested a delayed start (denied), implying Skene-area services were in scope, but site-level go-live not confirmed. Current EPR: Melior (part of SAS regionwide reversion).

hospitalSites.name: SkaS Skovde
hospitalSites.notes: Main acute site.

hospitalSites.name: Angereds Narsjukhus
hospitalSites.notes: Mixed acute+primary scope.

hospitalSites.name: Hogsbo narsjukhus
hospitalSites.beds_notes: No inpatient beds — day-surgery/outpatient specialist only.
hospitalSites.notes: Successor to the closed Frolunda Specialistsjukhus (relocated here mid-Dec 2023). ~60 consultation rooms: cardiovascular, diabetes, orthopaedic, ophthalmology, ENT, dermatology, plastic surgery.

hospitalSites.name: SUS Lund
hospitalSites.beds_notes: SUS combined ~13,000 staff group-wide (indicative Wikipedia figure); per-campus beds not confirmed.
hospitalSites.notes: Millennium: none — was scheduled last in original rollout plan, cancelled before reaching it.

hospitalSites.name: SUS Malmo
hospitalSites.notes: Millennium: none.

hospitalSites.name: Helsingborgs lasarett
hospitalSites.notes: ~3,000 staff. Millennium: none found.

hospitalSites.name: Angelholms sjukhus
hospitalSites.notes: Aleris Specialistvard operates an ortho/eye clinic on-site under contract ("Angelholmsandan" model). Millennium: none found.

hospitalSites.name: Centralsjukhuset Kristianstad (CSK)
hospitalSites.notes: ~2,000 staff. Millennium: none found.

hospitalSites.name: Hassleholms sjukhus
hospitalSites.notes: ~500 staff. One of Sweden's largest hip/knee orthopaedic prosthesis centres. Millennium: none found.

hospitalSites.name: Lasarettet i Ystad
hospitalSites.notes: Designated Millennium pilot site (originally the wider planned southeast-Skane rollout, scaled back to Ystad alone after the VGR/Boras failure); go-live repeatedly postponed with no date set as of 21 Jan 2026; programme cancelled entirely 29 Apr 2026 — never launched.

hospitalSites.name: Lasarettet Trelleborg
hospitalSites.notes: Ortho (hip/knee), day surgery, psychiatric, palliative services. Millennium: none found.

hospitalSites.name: Lasarettet i Landskrona
hospitalSites.notes: Smaller elective-surgery hospital (gallstones, hernias, some cancer surgery); 24/7 inpatient wards; weekday-daytime-only adult ED. Shares diagnostics/imaging with Helsingborg + Angelholm. Millennium: none found.

hospitalSites.name: Capio Narsjukhus Simrishamn
hospitalSites.notes: Frail elderly specialist outpatient/inpatient care; also youth health (Simrishamn/Tomelilla) + co-located Capio Vardcentral Simrishamn primary care. Street address unconfirmed.

hospitalSites.name: Akademiska sjukhuset
hospitalSites.beds_notes: 940 beds — stale figure, dated 2017; active 2025 debate about capacity cuts, do not treat as current.
hospitalSites.notes: No street-level address surfaced.

hospitalSites.name: Lasarettet i Enkoping
hospitalSites.notes: Lansdels- och akutsjukhus for the southern part of the county.

hospitalSites.name: Vrinnevisjukhuset
hospitalSites.notes: ~2,500 employees.

hospitalSites.name: Lasarettet i Motala
hospitalSites.notes: Capio specialistvard operates orthopaedics, surgery, dermatology and anaesthesia departments here under contract — private-operator-within-public-site.

hospitalSites.name: Centrallasarettet Vaxjo
hospitalSites.notes: Address needs disambiguation between two campus entrances.

hospitalSites.name: Visby lasarett
hospitalSites.notes: No clean current bed total found; Wikipedia (2024) notes highest beds-per-inhabitant in the country; 5 ICU beds as of Nov 2020.

hospitalSites.name: Blekingesjukhuset Karlskrona
hospitalSites.notes: Main/larger campus per shared-services page.

hospitalSites.name: Hallands sjukhus Halmstad
hospitalSites.beds_notes: Only seasonal-closure figures found (e.g. '150 vardplatser closed for summer') — not a reliable baseline.

hospitalSites.name: Hallands sjukhus Varberg
hospitalSites.beds_notes: Wikipedia states '450 somatic + 50 psychiatric' but undated/possibly stale — re-verify before use.
hospitalSites.notes: Building opened 1 June 1972.

hospitalSites.name: Hallands sjukhus Kungsbacka
hospitalSites.notes: Planned/elective specialist only (medicine, surgery, urology, ortho, gynae, ENT, eye, paediatrics, palliative, geriatric rehab, post-op) — NO emergency department.

hospitalSites.name: Vastmanlands sjukhus Vasteras
hospitalSites.notes: Largest hospital in the county — full range incl. surgery, oncology, psychiatry, paediatrics.

hospitalSites.name: Vastmanlands sjukhus Koping
hospitalSites.notes: ~400 staff, 4 wards; primary focus acute internal medicine; serves Koping-Arboga-Kungsor + Hallstahammar + northern county.

hospitalSites.name: Avesta lasarett
hospitalSites.notes: Postcode discrepancy across sources (774 41 vs 774 82).

hospitalSites.name: Saters sjukhus (Skonvik)
hospitalSites.notes: Adult psychiatry, psychiatric ED, forensic psychiatry (own notable clinic), youth services, pain referral.

hospitalSites.name: Borlange sjukhus
hospitalSites.notes: Hosts Jourmottagning Mellersta Dalarna (central-Dalarna out-of-hours/emergency reception) + palliative team. Exact classification (full lasarett vs. narsjukhus-equivalent) unclear.

hospitalSites.name: Solleftea sjukhus
hospitalSites.beds_notes: 81 beds (Feb 2020 figure; a proposed ~20% cut to 65 was under debate then — outcome not verified, treat as dated).

hospitalSites.name: Ostersunds sjukhus
hospitalSites.notes: Street address unconfirmed (postal Box 654).

hospitalSites.name: Norrlands universitetssjukhus
hospitalSites.beds_notes: Only a 1907 historical figure of 134 found — no current total.
hospitalSites.notes: Address unconfirmed/conflicting across sources (main campus Alidbacken area; patient hotel Lasarettsbacken 10).

hospitalSites.name: Lycksele sjukhus
hospitalSites.notes: Single-source directory listing, not cross-verified.

hospitalSites.name: Kiruna sjukhus
hospitalSites.beds_notes: 29 established (from 33) — 2018 board doc, likely stale; no new figure for the planned replacement hospital yet.

hospitalSites.name: Malarsjukhuset
hospitalSites.notes: Address conflicting across sources (Kungsvagen 38 vs Kungsgatan 42; additional buildings at Kungsvagen 36/69, Sveavagen 42) — needs reconciliation. Overall beds unconfirmed.

hospitalSites.name: Nykopings lasarett
hospitalSites.notes: Street address not found.

hospitalSites.name: Regionsjukhuset Karsudden (Karsuddens sjukhus)
hospitalSites.beds_notes: 155 beds across 14 wards/7 units (2025 figure; was 235 at 1964 opening, 245 in 1967).
hospitalSites.notes: Sweden's largest forensic psychiatric hospital. Precise street address unconfirmed.

procurementNotices.title: VGR Cerner/Oracle Health Millennium EPR contract and termination
procurementNotices.notes: Originally procured 2017-18 (>SEK 5bn). Live 12 Nov 2024 at Sodra Alvsborgs Sjukhus (Boras) + Narhalsan clinics; suspended after 3 days (15 Nov 2024); regional board voted to abandon 2 Dec 2025; termination settlement SEK 657m signed 27 Aug 2026 on top of ~SEK 3.8bn already invested. VGR continues on legacy Melior under a new modular EPR strategy (no fixed timeline).

procurementNotices.title: Region Skane Cerner/Oracle Health Millennium EPR contract (SDV) and discontinuation
procurementNotices.notes: Procured 2016-17, branded internally SDV (Skanes Digitala Vardsystem). Never reached a confirmed production or pilot go-live anywhere in the region (planned Ystad pilot repeatedly postponed). Regional board voted to discontinue 29 Apr 2026 after an internal usability review found the system not fit for purpose and lacking EU MDR CE certification. Total sunk cost ~SEK 3.5bn (2.3bn investment, 1.14bn consultants, 620.1m Cerner/Oracle fees, 838.8m internal staff). Inquiry opened into the original 2017 procurement decision after media reports of possible irregularities. Replacement decision expected ~Oct 2026.

procurementNotices.title: KGC (Kundgrupp Cosmic) Cambio COSMIC contract renewal
procurementNotices.notes: 8-region consortium (Uppsala, Ostergotland, Jonkoping, Kronoberg, Kalmar, Jamtland Harjedalen, Varmland, Vastmanland) + private Capio S:t Gorans Sjukhus. Renewed 30 Nov 2023, effective 1 Jan 2024, 5yr + 3yr option.

procurementNotices.title: Sussa Samverkan Cambio COSMIC joint procurement
procurementNotices.notes: 9-region collaboration (Orebro, Norrbotten, Vasternorrland, Halland, Vasterbotten, Dalarna, Sormland, Gavleborg, Blekinge) procured Cambio COSMIC to replace NCS Cross/VAS/TakeCare; contract >SEK 4.3bn/10yr + extensions. Rollout completed Nov 2025 (Blekinge last). CONTESTED: SVT Uppdrag Granskning (29-30 Apr 2026) reported that Cambio's technical evaluation scores were reportedly raised at 11 points without documented justification, turning a losing evaluation into a 2-point win; a procurement law expert called it potentially unlawful. No reversal reported as of Sept 2026.

procurementNotices.title: Region Stockholm + Gotland Cambio COSMIC contract
procurementNotices.notes: Signed Nov 2025; replaces legacy TakeCare across Region Stockholm + Region Gotland. Value SEK 2.3bn/12yr (total cost to taxpayer estimated SEK 10-14bn per press reporting). Contested by losing bidders (Systematic A/S, CGM), resolved Oct 2025. Phased 5-yr rollout, target completion ~2029.
